accepted.reason: All four factor subgroups meet C trivially; the reduced nonempty word ab lies in both generated subgroups while both local intersections are trivial. The exact infinite intersection is the even-word subgroup of C2*C2, namely the infinite cyclic group generated by ab. The finite image is only a separating validation.

Both base subgroups satisfy the identity associated-subgroup compatibility. Their common word ata has a second expression through ac and t. The S3×C2 image separates it from the stable-letter cyclic subgroup, disproving the literal unrestricted formula.

accepted.reason: Cancellation of backtracking identification paths proves block embeddings and connected support subtrees. Full edge embeddings transport simplices; finite subtree Helly puts every clique into one block. This proves fullness and flagness for arbitrary, possibly infinite trees and complexes.

accepted.reason: Input flag transitivity identifies the common residue with each private-face link, so edge complexes are full closed stars after adjoining missing private types. Chamber labels glue as G/H. For every face the locally supporting edges are exactly D_A C/C and D_B C/C, by flag transitivity on the union with the private face. Their tree paths give the full stabilizer generated by D_A and D_B, whose common subgroup is the coherently identified D_C. This establishes every parabolic and identifies global vertex incidence with coset incidence.

accepted.reason: Residues use the same construction with residual type sets. Containing one private-type set collapses one factor and recovers an input residue. Otherwise both types remain privately, each block is a cone and edge complexes have vertices, proving connectedness. Every panel collapses to an input panel; shared-type panels coincide under the fixed parabolic identification. All input panel indices occur, giving both directions for firmness, thinness and thickness.

edge_cases.arbitrary_Borel: H need not be trivial or core-free. Chambers are cosets G/H, not necessarily group elements. No step requires faithful actions; the separate finite diagnostic uses a nontrivial ineffective Borel.
edge_cases.empty_private_P: C=A and G=A*_A B identifies with B. A-blocks are redundant stars; all formulas collapse to the B parabolics. Local supporting-edge formula also holds since the P face is empty.
edge_cases.both_private_empty: The fixed compatible identification gives A=B=C and reproduces the original geometry.
edge_cases.empty_face: D_A=A, D_B=B and D_C=C, hence stabilizer G.
edge_cases.whole_chamber: D_A=D_B=D_C=H, hence chamber stabilizer H without a faithfulness assumption.
edge_cases.rank_zero_or_one: The complex construction and collapse cases remain valid; residual connectivity imposes only the usual rank-at-least-two conditions; panel indices are unchanged.
edge_cases.infinite_groups: No finiteness of A, B, C, H or index sets of blocks is assumed. Finite rank ensures each flag/clique uses finitely many vertices.

compatibility_qualification: The current theorem requires one fixed amalgamating isomorphism to respect every designated parabolic. Source Definition 3.16 literally lists abstract subgroup isomorphisms; that bare list is not silently promoted to a coherent fixed identification.
